blocks.tamil_translation: levels, which Allah has prepared for those who sacrifice in His path; the distance between each of these levels is the distance between the heavens and the earth. When you ask Allah for Jannah, ask for “Jannat-ul-Firdaus”, for it is the best of everything in Jannah, the very highest abode. Above it is the “Arsh” of the Most Merciful, and from it the rivers of Jannah spring forth.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: خَمْسٌ مَنْ جَاءَ بِهِنَّ مَعَ إِيمَانٍ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ: مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَي الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ عَلَي وُضُوئِهِنَّ وَرُكُوعِهِنَّ وَسُجُودِهِنَّ وَمَوَاقِيتِهِنَّ، وَصَامَ رَمَضَانَ، وَحَجَّ الْبَيْتَ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلاً، وَآتَي الزَّكَاةَ طَيَّبِةً بِهَا نَفْسُهُ، وَأَدَّي الاَمَانَةَ، قِيلَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! وَمَا أَدَاءُ اْلاَمَانَةِ؟ قَالَ الْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ إِنَّ اللهَ لَمْ يَأْمَنِ ابْنَ آدَمَ عَلَي شَيْءٍ مِنْ دِينِهِ غَيْرَهَا.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Darda (RA) narrates, “Whoever comes (into the presence of Allah) having done five deeds with Iman will enter Jannah: performing the five daily Salahs, fulfilling their Wudu, Ruku' and Sujud in the correct manner, and carefully performing them at their proper times; fasting in the month of Ramadan; performing Hajj if one has the ability to perform Hajj; giving Zakat willingly; and fulfilling the trust (Amanah).” When the Prophet ﷺ said this, it was asked, “O Messenger of Allah! What does fulfilling the trust mean?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “The obligatory bath (Ghusl).’ For, among the deeds of the son of Adam, other than the obligatory bath, Allah has not made any deed
